description:
The Role

We're hiring another Customer Success Manager to own a book of business across our Pro package clients. You'll be the main point of contact for your accounts from onboarding through renewal, responsible for adoption, retention, and growth. This is a high-ownership role, so you'll touch everything from day-one onboarding to churn saves to surfacing product gaps back to the team.

What You'll Do

  • Own onboarding for new subscribers, getting accounts to first value fast (creator search, outreach setup, Spark Codes, GMV tracking, campaigns) and running a structured onboarding sequence over the first 60 days

  • Manage a portfolio of brand and agency accounts, running regular check-ins and walkthroughs to drive adoption and expansion

  • Monitor account health and act on churn signals before they become cancellations, including win-back and retention outreach on at-risk accounts

  • Run failed payment recovery and billing follow-up to protect MRR

  • Pull and interpret usage and subscription data to prioritize where to spend your time, and report on your book's health

  • Capture customer feedback and feature requests, turn them into clear product asks, and track them through to resolution

  • Support Reacher Plus clients where managed service and software overlap

  • Keep account context, notes, and next steps clean and current

  • Join demo calls as the platform expert with the sales team whenever needed

You'll Be Successful If You

  • Have 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a client-facing role

  • Have hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop, including strategy, affiliate programs, and automation tools; agency background preferred

  • Are a strong communicator who can build rapport quickly and maintain trust over time

  • Are comfortable managing clients

  • Are highly organized with a bias toward follow-through and accountability

  • Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where speed and scrappiness are key
